content: Next.js next/font/local self-hosts local font files (woff2/woff/ttf) at build time with zero runtime requests to any third-party CDN, colocating font files in the app directory and exposing a className/variable via a local font loader. next/font/google similarly downloads Google Fonts at build time and self-hosts them from the app's own origin -- 'no requests sent to Google by the browser' per Next.js docs. Both mechanisms satisfy a self-hosted-fonts/no-third-party-CDN requirement.
